title: The fridges and freezers
summary: Chilled storage in Supermarket Simulator is a line of its own: the game names fridges and freezers in sizes, repeats each size in twelve colourways, and gives the chiller display slots and surfaces of its own.
body: Chilled storage is bought as its own furniture rather than borrowed from the shelves. The game names fridges and freezers in sizes, so a small aisle and a big one are fitted with different pieces of the same family.

The sizes are kept apart. There is a mini, a medium and a double fridge, and a single, a double and a triple freezer, which is why a chiller can be chosen for the space rather than for the stock alone.

Each size is named again in colours. Twelve colourways run from dune and gulf stream through to terracotta and viola, so a chiller can be matched to the rest of the shop's furniture instead of standing out as the one grey box in the room.
The chiller holds its own display space. It has display slots of its own, one named for a fridge and one for a freezer, which is why chilled goods are placed in it rather than on an ordinary shelf.

Its surfaces are its own as well. The build names a body sheet for the fridge and a trim sheet beside it, with a normal map and an emissive sheet for each, so the chiller does not simply take on the shop's wall finish.

The build even ships artwork for the pieces themselves. There is a picture of a double fridge and pictures of the freezers, which is why the screens can show what you are buying without loading the furniture.
The image beside this entry is the game's own: the double display fridge it ships, with glass doors and shelves inside.
What this entry does not tell you: what any chiller costs, how much it holds, or how quickly chilled goods sell. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The chillers are named in sizes: a mini, a medium and a double fridge, and a single, a double and a triple freezer.
facts.evidence: asset names: FridgeMini_1Default, FridgeMedium_1Default, FridgeDouble_1Default, Freezer_Single, Freezer_Double, Freezer_Triple

facts.claim: Each size is named again per colourway, twelve of them, from dune and gulf stream to terracotta and viola.
facts.evidence: asset names: Freezer_Double_Dune, Freezer_Double_Viola, FridgeMedium_Rock Blue, FridgeMini_Sprout

facts.claim: The chiller has display slots of its own, one for a fridge and one for a freezer.
facts.evidence: asset names: Display Slot (Fridge), Display Slot (Freezer)

facts.claim: The fridge's surfaces are named: a body sheet, a normal map and an emissive sheet, with a trim sheet of its own beside them.
facts.evidence: asset names: T_Fridge_RGBA, T_Fridge_Normal, T_Fridge_Emmisive, T_FridgesTrim_AlbedoTransparency, T_FridgesTrim_Normal, T_FridgesTrim_Emmisive

facts.claim: The build ships artwork for the pieces themselves: a double fridge and the freezers among the pictures.
